note: The open-source Notion MCP server names each tool API-<operationId> of this OpenAPI spec; path parameters become arguments. Descriptions and argument names from the spec, schemas trimmed.

tools.name: API-patch-page
tools.description: Notion | Update page properties. Also moves a page to or from the trash (in_trash) and sets its icon or cover.

properties.description: The property values to update for the page. The keys are the names or IDs of the property and the values are property values.

in_trash.description: Set to true to delete a block. Set to false to restore a block.

tools.name: API-patch-block-children
tools.description: Notion | Append block children: child content appended to a container block (a page is a block).

block_id.description: Identifier for a block. Also accepts a page ID.

children.description: Child content to append to a container block as an array of block objects

after.description: The ID of the existing block that the new block should be appended after.

tools.name: API-update-a-block
tools.description: Notion | Update a block. Only text (for supported block types) and checked (for to_do blocks) can be updated; archived: true deletes the block.

type.description: The block object type value with the properties to be updated, e.g. {"to_do": {"checked": true}}

archived.description: Set to true to archive (delete) a block. Set to false to un-archive (restore) a block.

tools.name: API-delete-a-block
tools.description: Notion | Delete a block (moves it to the trash).

tools.name: API-post-page
tools.description: Notion | Create a page, under a page or as a row of a database.

properties.description: The property values for the new page.

tools.name: API-get-block-children
tools.description: Notion | Retrieve block children (a page's content).

tools.name: API-query-data-source
tools.description: Notion | Query a data source (the rows of a database).

tools.name: API-create-a-comment
tools.description: Notion | Create comment on a page.
